source: User follow-up during TASK-047: runtime should be a domain entity; agency is one part of runtime; user said move forward completely.

loop_start.reason: Compiler loops start from CodeWiki source refs; agents may refresh context when chat is noisy, stale, or token-heavy.

validation.reason: Fresh validation is preferred; policy may require it for high-risk semantic gates.

next_loop.reason: The next compiler loop should start from CodeWiki source refs; the agent may refresh context when useful.

summary: Approve runtime as a CodeWiki source concept root and move bounded execution orchestration out of agency.

diff_table.current_state: Bounded runner execution mechanics live under src/agency/runner.ts, while agency docs define both policy/planning and execution orchestration. Existing concept roots include src/agency, src/session, src/state, and src/validation, but no src/runtime package-source root.
diff_table.desired_state: Create a narrow src/runtime/** concept root for bounded execution runtime orchestration: selecting a safe step, coordinating claims, invoking agency policy/planning, calling compiler/gateway preparation, handling context-boundary requests, and recording workflow-efficiency evidence.
diff_table.rationale: Runtime is broader than agency and makes execution mechanics a first-class domain entity instead of overloading agency. Agency remains the autonomy/policy/controller concept; runtime owns bounded run execution.
diff_table.risk: Medium architecture churn: runtime name can become a dumping ground or be confused with .codewiki/runtime dogfood state unless scope is tightly defined.
alternatives: Keep src/agency/runner.ts and document agency as both policy and runtime executor.
Use src/orchestration/** instead of src/runtime/** to avoid collision with .codewiki/runtime.
Use a generic src/runner/** root, but this is less domain-specific and likely too narrow.

diff_table.current_state: src/agency/tool.ts plans agency work and directly attaches runner execution. src/agency/runner.ts imports session claims, resume context, validation preflight, and state kickoff concerns.
diff_table.desired_state: Keep src/agency/** focused on agency policy, planning, budget/risk gates, and the codewiki_agency public entrypoint. Move runAgencyStep and runner result types to src/runtime/**, with agency used by runtime rather than runtime living inside agency.
diff_table.rationale: Dependency direction becomes clearer: adapter/tool -> agency entrypoint -> runtime executor -> agency planning/policy + session/state/validation services. The runtime can later support sprint/roadmap runners without making agency a catch-all.
diff_table.risk: Need update file-structure docs, component map/diagrams, source-root tests, smoke tests, and possibly API docs before moving files.

accepted_decisions.summary: Runtime is a first-class CodeWiki package-source concept root under src/runtime/**.
Agency remains the policy/planning/autonomy controller and uses runtime for bounded execution.
Harness runtimes such as Pi expose capabilities through adapter ports; CodeWiki runtime requests them and records platform limitations when unsupported.

knowledge_changes: Updated .codewiki/kb/system/agency.md to distinguish agency policy from runtime execution.
Updated .codewiki/kb/system/file-structure.md with runtime component-doc mapping and source root.
Updated component-map and file-structure-map diagrams with runtime node/root.

row_to_kb_mappings.evidence: Added runtime.md defining CodeWiki runtime as package-source bounded execution orchestration distinct from harness runtimes and .codewiki/runtime state; file-structure/API now list src/runtime/** as concept root and capability.

Agency doc now owns autonomy/policy/planning, while runtime owns claim/gateway/context-boundary execution; component map shows agency authorizing runtime and runtime invoking resume/gateway/compiler work.

product_impact: No user-facing command change required; codewiki_agency remains the surface while implementation boundaries become clearer.
system_impact: Adds src/runtime/** as a concept root for bounded execution orchestration.
Keeps src/agency/** focused on agency policy, planning, approval cadence, and tool entrypoint.
Clarifies adapter/harness runtime boundary through runtime ports.
